prompt_text: Which residential pest control companies are the most reputable in the West US (California, Washington, Arizona)?
response_text:
When selecting a reputable residential pest control company in the Western United States—specifically in California, Washington, and Arizona—it's essential to consider providers with a strong track record, comprehensive services, and positive customer feedback. Here are some notable companies operating in these states:

**1. Western Exterminator**

With nearly a century of experience, Western Exterminator serves most metro areas in Washington, Oregon, California, Idaho, Nevada, and Arizona. They offer green treatment options for both commercial and residential pest control and provide free inspections without requiring annual contracts. ([pests.org](https://www.pests.org/top-5-pest-control-companies/?utm_source=openai))

**2. Orkin**

Operating in 47 states, including Arizona, Orkin offers personalized pest control solutions tailored to specific regional challenges. They provide same-day and next-day services, backed by over 125 years of experience. ([orkin.com](https://www.orkin.com/locations/arizona-az?utm_source=openai))

**3. Clark Pest Control**

Serving California and Nevada since 1950, Clark Pest Control offers a range of services, including termite control, ant control, rodent control, and more. They emphasize integrated pest management and provide a satisfaction guarantee on every job. ([clarkpest.com](https://www.clarkpest.com/pest-control?utm_source=openai))

**4. Brooks Pest Control**

Protecting homes across the West Coast since 2017, Brooks Pest Control offers fast, eco-friendly, same-day services with a 100% satisfaction guarantee. They handle a variety of pests, including ants, mosquitoes, and cockroaches. ([brookspest.com](https://www.brookspest.com/?utm_source=openai))

**5. Truly Nolen**

As one of the world's largest family-owned pest control companies, Truly Nolen operates over 70 corporate locations in the United States, including Arizona. They offer comprehensive pest control services and are recognized for their distinctive yellow mouse car branding. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Truly_Nolen?utm_source=openai))

When choosing a pest control provider, consider factors such as the company's experience, range of services, customer reviews, and commitment to safety and environmental responsibility. It's also advisable to contact the companies directly to discuss your specific needs and obtain quotes.
